description: This script provides functions for handling boot partitions, UUID extraction, mounting, copying configurations, and upgrading firmware components on i.MX devices within the OpenWrt project.

methods.name: rootpartuuid
methods.description: Extracts the root partition UUID from kernel command line.

methods.name: bootdev_from_uuid
methods.description: Gets the device name for the boot partition based on UUID.

methods.name: bootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Gets the device name for the boot partition (partition 1) based on UUID.

methods.name: rootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Gets the device name for the root partition (partition 2) based on UUID.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration to the /boot partition.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a firmware upgrade using the provided image tarball.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade preparations such as resetting JFFS2 and unmounting overlay.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_move_config
methods.description: Moves saved configuration from /boot to the root filesystem if the boot partition is a block device.
